## Type

Client support request (how-to question).

## Request

* **Requested by:** Emily (WagerTech), 2026-09-30 9:51 AM ET, in the shared Slack channel.
* **Ask:** How an Ops user can filter the full "All" Sign-Ups list to one Brand Ambassador's (BA) signups in split view. Follow-ups at 10:27 AM: (1) is the only way to filter split view to filter in table view first, and (2) can the BA filter value be a picklist instead of an open text field.
* **Slack (client):** https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BBC05C2HG/p1790776304286699

## Internal notes

* Split view does not support filtering or sorting. Filter in table view, then switch back to split view. The filter stays applied. Confirmed in the org, and it matches the Salesforce Ben guide: https://www.salesforceben.com/your-complete-guide-to-salesforce-split-view/
* BA is a lookup field, so the filter value is a plain text box, not a picklist. Standard list view filters do not offer a picklist for a lookup field. If Ops filters on the same BAs often, saved list views per BA are the simple workaround.
* **Loom (sent to Emily):** https://www.loom.com/share/41a591647ff84469974807c276c906ef
* **Related:** WAGR-501 (Show Brand Ambassador more prominently in the Ops list view), which captures the build request.

## Next steps

- [x] Taryn: record a Loom showing how to filter by BA (table view) and share it with Emily.
- [x] Confirm to Emily that filters and sorting only work in table view.
- [ ] Taryn: reply to Emily that the BA filter value stays a text box (lookup), and offer saved BA list views if she wants them.
fields.summary: Support: Emily — filter Sign-Ups by Brand Ambassador in split view
